subject.title: fix(meeting-bot): avoid stale state during transcript and browser recovery

question: Should browser-managed Google Meet talkback intentionally change from allowing an unknown microphone state to requiring an explicit `micMuted: false` observation before it may start or recover audio?
rationale: The preceding extraction treated `micMuted !== true` readiness as a shipped-behavior contract, while this PR replaces it with a fail-closed availability policy that can leave existing browser-managed sessions blocked until DOM health is observed.

options.title: Approve fail-closed readiness
options.body: Keep the explicit-unmuted requirement and document it as the intended safety policy after live proof confirms recovery remains usable.

options.title: Preserve current readiness default
options.body: Retain unknown-state compatibility by default and introduce strict microphone verification only through an explicitly approved, documented policy path.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed readiness
recommendation.body: Keep the explicit-unmuted requirement and document it as the intended safety policy after live proof confirms recovery remains usable.
